# Verdin

> Open source headless CMS written in Rust, compatible with Strapi v5 content APIs.

## Documentation Sets

- [Abridged documentation](https://verdin-cms.github.io/verdin/llms-small.txt): a compact version of the documentation for Verdin, with non-essential content removed
- [Complete documentation](https://verdin-cms.github.io/verdin/llms-full.txt): the full documentation for Verdin

## Notes

- The complete documentation includes all content from the official documentation
- The content is automatically generated from the same source as the official documentation
